Loading policy: local development and tests only. The library is ad-hoc signed,
not notarized, and must not be published or distributed. Do not bypass macOS
security controls if loading is blocked.

Validated symbols used by OpenTUIShim:
createRenderer, destroyRenderer, render, resizeRenderer,
getNextBuffer, getCurrentBuffer, bufferClear, bufferDrawText,
getBufferWidth, getBufferHeight, setCursorPosition,
setupTerminal, enableMouse, disableMouse, restoreTerminalModes

Intentional host-owned operations:
stdin reading and key/mouse/paste/resize event decoding remain in
LingXiTUI's POSIXTerminalBackend because this artifact exports no input
event dispatcher or stdin parser. embeddedTerminal* symbols are not used.
